title: Open restriction of a disjoint derived direct image vanishes
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian coefficient category, $i:Z\to X$ a scheme morphism and $j:U\to X$ an open immersion with disjoint images [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-open-immersion]. For every $N\in D(Z_{\mathrm{et}},\mathcal A)$, one has $D(j^*)Ri_*N=0$, with the direct and inverse image functors of [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] on the ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

proof.text: Represent N by a K-injective complex I. The total right derived direct image is represented by i_*I.
For every degree, j^*i_*I^n is zero by disjointness. Thus the identity of the termwise composite complex is zero componentwise.
Localization takes this zero complex to zero. Its factorization through the exact pullback identifies that object with D(j^*)Ri_*N.
